Concept manifolds in Llama-3.1-8B

A replication of the concept manifolds reported in Goodfire's Neural Geometry series and the papers behind it. Each entry shows a 3-D PCA of residual-stream activations (last token), the shape the source reports, a quantitative shape check, and a replication badge. Nothing here is hand-edited: badges come from the checks.
